provenance.method: Category tree structure (parents, sibling order) from the kintone UI baseline (p4-appc-baseline.md); record category values cross-checked via GET /k/v1/records.json with the app API token after the token was re-saved and the app updated on 2026-11-23. kintone exposes no category-tree REST read for API tokens, so the tree is an out-of-band capture.
provenance.nameForms: Node names are recorded in the simplified glyph forms evidenced by the records API (code points verified: 关 U+5173, 东 U+4E1C). The UI baseline noted traditional forms; the API-evidenced forms are authoritative for extraction matching because record values arrive in these forms. The Kansai node is never referenced by any record, so its stored glyph form cannot be read through the API; it is recorded in the same simplified form as the other nodes by batch consistency and flagged here as inferred.
provenance.nodeIdentity: Node identity keys: kintone category ids 2107 (Kanto) and 2108 (Tokyo) were read from the source UI and are used verbatim. The remaining nodes' kintone ids were not captured, so they are keyed by full path (path:...) as the frozen brief allows (node id primary, path acceptable where ids cannot be obtained). Parent links reference these keys.
